look_here_first: Densely hairy perennial bladderpod with several stems from the base, bright yellow flowers in tight clusters, and small globose to ellipsoid fruits.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: few to several stems from base

lookalikes.differences: The key split is perennial + dense compact flower cluster. P. densiflora is an annual; P. gracilis is more open, delicate, and spreading.
